title: A helper changes a member
prompt: `health` is a variable at the top of the script (a member variable) starting at 100. Write `take_damage`, which takes an amount and subtracts it from health. In `solve`, call take_damage(30) and return health, which is then 70.
hints: Because health is a member, a helper can change it and solve sees the change.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.
